Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge is a hospital operating within [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]]. It is one of the healthcare institutions evaluated in the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) annual report, which covers the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023. The hospital's clinical performance is tracked across multiple quality indicators coordinated by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) to ensure standardized care for atrial fibrillation patients across the Danish healthcare system.

Regarding [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the performance of echocardiography in newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients, Sjællands Universitetshospital Køge recorded a fulfillment rate of 45.6% (95% CI: 40.0–51.2) [^src3]. This result indicates that the hospital did not meet the national standard for this specific diagnostic procedure during the reporting year, highlighting an area for clinical quality improvement [^src3].

The hospital is also evaluated on anticoagulation treatment metrics. In the five-year analysis for treatment coverage (Indikator 4a), the hospital achieved a rate of 80.4% (95% CI: 66.9–90.2) [^src1]. For the two-year analysis of the same indicator, the coverage rate was slightly higher at 89.6% (95% CI: 82.5–94.5) [^src4]. Furthermore, the hospital successfully met the standard for another primary anticoagulation metric (likely time to treatment initiation), achieving a 93.1% (95% CI: 88.5–96.3) fulfillment rate [^src2]. These figures illustrate the hospital's varied performance across different stages of atrial fibrillation management.
